title: Who Does Not Attend the Live Broadcast Is Losing
body:
(...transmission problems...)
...We are losing. I am asking from my representative, who is representing us, to give much more attention
through the east and the west, to everyone. To reach more and more from the heavenly treasures. One
heavenly diamond, one heavenly emerald, one heavenly ruby, one heavenly pearl, if you can reach these it is
much more valuable than not only one of this dunya's treasures, but billions of this dunya's treasures are
nothing in front of that heavenly jewel!
O People! Use your minds! This is a heavenly order from the Lord of the Heavens to his messengers, to make
people ask for real values and heavenly jewels. O People! You are saying it doesn't matter, but you are losing
where are you reaching if you are not attending for half-an-hour, which, among those who are attending and
believing and keeping their respect, there is only one jewel, one diamond that has been granted to you! This
dunya is so worthless! Therefore, O people through the east and the west, you must try and attend what we
are in now. Heavenly centers are making an opening through heavenly knowledge to people living on this
planet. Give that value and take much more countless jewels. Don't be heedless, O Mankind in the east and
the west! One bird may suddenly speak and address who is in its presence. Oh never reminding in the east
and west, all newspapers are making a very important news that, “In Africa they are finding a bird that is

speaking like a man."
All people are saying, "Did you hear, that bird was speaking like a man."
"Where is it??"
"Look tonight, they are showing!"
If they found a bird speaking like a man, that night they will make a show and you will be astonished. It is a
mu`jizah, a miraculous thing. One bird is speaking, and the whole world is taking care, saying, "That bird is
speaking."
"O my brother, I am telling you that at the same time that the whole world is looking to that bird that is
speaking like a man, I had a donkey and I am hearing that it is saying, 'O People! O heedless ones! Why are
you not listening to that one who is speaking to you heavenly news?' I am looking, from where is this coming?
I am looking to my donkey with his ears like this, he is looking to me. 'You are also from those heedless ones.
You are taking amusement to hear that one bird is speaking like a man. And a man is speaking to you and you
are not giving him value? Ptuu!!'"
(Mawlana Shaykh laughs) That donkey making ptuuh (spits) on that person.
The donkey continues, “You are not hearing that declaration everyday of that one who is coming and
speaking to you? Is it not valuable? But you are saying that a bird who is addressing people with their names
also, that is miraculous, and a man is speaking, it is not miraculous.”
That is the meezaan, scale of all of you, 21st century-people’s mentality. They are giving a value because one
bird is speaking like a man, but if a man is speaking they say it doesn't matter! There is no value. There's a
value if the bird is speaking. Ptuu on such a mentality!! That is mu`amala, the treatment of nations for their
prophets! I am not a prophet. But the custom of people is to deny all prophets and they are saying, “You are
not speaking truth and we are not believing you.” That is the mentality of common people and their value is
of animals and under them!!
We are saying now, A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. O People,
run away from shaytanic mentalities! Countless numbers of Shaytan's agents are making people deny

prophets and their inheritors, yes. Those peoples' levels are going to be the level of the birds speaking to
them. They will be very happy with birds speaking to them, and all around they are looking, saying, "Where
are we living? Yes, birds are speaking to me. How am I a bird? I was a man." Yes, you were a man, but your
mentality was at the level of birds, and therefore, you have been sent to the reality of animals, because when
an animal or bird was speaking, you were surprised and astonished. So we are putting you in that level of
animals so you can be happy. Because you weren't happy when one prophet was coming and saying, "O
people, I have been sent from the heavens with a heavenly message, to make for you a way to the heavens!"
But you are like animals, you were kicking him and running away! Therefore, you have been made to be on
the level of animals, that kicks and bites every second one.
O People! This is a heavenly warning! Don't say you are busy, for your busy-ness is nothing. Your final point
of busy-ness is reaching in the end to the WC (toilet). But who is asking from heavenly honors, their ways are
to heavenly enlightening, enlightened dominions of Allah (swt)! Allahu akbar! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and
sits).
O People! Yes, they are making this big servant to address people according to their understanding. O
`Ulamas! O `Ulamas! Wahhabi `ulamas or Salafi `ulamas or Azhari 'sh-Shareef doctors and Persian
ayatullah and hujatullah! Where are you from the Holy Qur'an? Don't blame me that I am speaking, as I am
not speaking--they are making me to speak! Yes, one part of the holy verse I am asking. What is Allah (swt),
the Lord of Heavens saying? (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) You are `ulamas who recite the holy verse,
••••••••• ••••• ••••••••
w 'adrib lahum mathalan, "Set forth to them, by way of a parable." (36:13)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits.) They are making me to make an example. Allah Almighty is ordering to prophets and
their inheritors to address people, and their Lord's addressing is from pre-Eternal to Eternal. That is giving
them the authority over learned people, to make examples for them, helping them understand. So don't say,
“That one is speaking.” According to the Holy Qur'an, w 'adrib lahum mathalan, that holy verse addresses
everyone that may speak to people, to make them help people understand by giving them an example or to
tell some tales.
Look, that is a ring and its value is according to its stone. You are `ulamas, and that is a precious stone. It is

not so precious, but there may be a diamond here (Mawlana Shaykh points to the ring.) No one can carry that
diamond in his hand, but putting here (bezel of the ring) and making a kursi, a throne, qa'ida, a base. Yes, if
this is not here you can't show it to people. And darabul mathal, giving an example, making it clear to show
this stone and to show people which thing is valuable. And now it is okay, people are knowing that I have a
precious ring and the ring is precious because of its stone.
Therefore, the Holy Qur'an has precious jewels and precious stones, and you can't show them people alone,
you may use this for showing people the value of those holy verses for understanding. Therefore, don't blame
me when they are making me speak from the Earth up to the skies, no! We are using this according to the
holy command of Allah Almighty, haythu yaa qul wadhrib lahum mathalan, "Where they say and present to
them." For what? For everything, to teach people everything. But without an understanding base, that
diamond can't be understood. Therefore, we are now speaking for half-an-hour and they are making me to
speak to people, to show some jewels, because all people living now are heedless or drunk or bad ones! That
is the value of the huge crowding of people on this planet. Either they are drunk or they are heedless or they
are never understanding, and there is no value for them. Therefore, we are waking them up with such
examples for understanding.
O People! You are not giving a quarter-of-an-hour for listening to this because you are saying, “I am busy.
There is no time." What is this busy-ness? You are going daily, ten times to the WC and you are so busy?
Make on your clothes if you are so busy! I am saying what they are saying to me. You are taking a bath daily
two times, once or more, and you are not saying, "I am too busy to take that bath!" Why are you not saying, “I
am so busy, I am not going to the toilet!” But for such an important thing you are saying you are busy! Your
graveyard is open for you, waiting, waiting. Why are you not saying, “I am too busy to go to the graveyard”?
Keep yourself and fear from Allah (swt)!!!
O `ulamas, baligh maa umirt, declare! You must do what you have been ordered, `ulamas! Don't make
discussions, no! Come on a simple level to make people to understand. May Allah forgive us. Astaghfirullah.
Astaghfirullah. That means you are not giving any value to be for Allah (swt). They are thinking I am making
a show here. No I am tis`een, 90-years-old; I am not in need to make a show of me. For what? But you must
think that perhaps your kafan, shroud, may be prepared after a few days.

May Allah forgive us.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah.
This anger, O attenders, I am making for my dirty ego and I am attacking on Shaytan and his followers, not
for good ones. First I am fighting for my dirty ego.
••••• ••••••••• ••••••••••• ••••••••••
Inna 'n-nafsa la-amaraatan bi 's-soow, the (human) soul is certainly prone to evil (12:53)
You must not forget, O `ulamas! `Ismah, divinely protection, is only for anbiyas (prophets) and those who
are on their steps.
Fatihah.
(36 minutes) Enough, enough. Alhamdulillah.
(Mawlana Shaykh sings)
Dome, dome, dome, dome 8x
This miraculous sweet singing is only for people with cleans ears, they may hear. O People! Turning around
our planet, but our ears are full with dirt. Open it and hear it is coming.
Dome, dome, dome, dome 8x
Never-ending. Allahu akbar, yaa Rabbee! Huuuuuuuuuuu. People are thinking that this is going to finish in
one year, two years. From when are the prophets speaking?
(Mawlana Shaykh speaks on the phone with Shaykh Hisham Effendi).
